name: econ_paper_studio_run
description: Run a bounded econ-paper-studio command through a trusted runner service and return the report text plus artifacts.

workspace_id.description: Server-side workspace/session identifier. The runner maps it to an allowed directory.

brief_path.description: Path to a research brief inside the allowed workspace.

skill_dir.description: Path to a mounted upstream skill directory inside the allowed workspace or runner reference area.

csv_path.description: Path to a CSV analysis file inside the allowed workspace.

ledger_path.description: Path to an evidence ledger JSON file inside the allowed workspace.

artifact_id.description: Evidence ledger artifact id for ledger_add.

artifact_path.description: Table or figure path inside the allowed workspace.

artifact_title.description: Human-readable table or figure title for the evidence ledger.

code_path.description: Script path that generated the artifact.

data_source.description: Data source or snapshot recorded in the evidence ledger.

sample.description: Analysis sample recorded in the evidence ledger.

model.description: Model or specification recorded in the evidence ledger.

estimand.description: Estimand recorded in the evidence ledger.

cluster.description: Cluster level recorded in the evidence ledger or used for data_audit.

claim.description: Claim supported by a ledger artifact.

analysis_path.description: Path to an analysis/session directory inside the allowed workspace.

paper_path.description: Path to a Markdown/LaTeX/text draft inside the allowed workspace.
